recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜仍在，但正常皮髓質結構部分消失：濾泡間區擴大、竇道擴張，只剩少數小濾泡，並散在淡染的圓形結節，提示淋巴結被浸潤性病變（此病例為系統性肥大細胞增生症）部分取代。
features: Partial effacement of nodal architecture with expanded interfollicular/paracortical areas
Dilated, patent sinuses forming a reticulated pattern throughout the node
Few scattered small lymphoid follicles, some with small germinal centers
Scattered pale, rounded nodules of pale-staining cells within the node
Intact capsule with perinodal adipose tissue; no capsular breach evident at this power
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a lymph node shows an intact capsule with perinodal fat and partial effacement of the normal architecture. The interfollicular areas are expanded, the sinuses are dilated, and only a few small follicles with germinal centers remain. Scattered pale-staining rounded nodules are present within the parenchyma; their cellular composition cannot be resolved at this magnification. In the context of systemic mastocytosis, findings are suggestive of nodal involvement and warrant tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves sinuses and lacks aggregates of spindled CD117+/CD25+ mast cells on IHC.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+ in a mixed inflammatory background rather than tryptase-positive mast cell aggregates.
Rosai-Dorfman disease shows markedly distended sinuses filled with large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis, rather than interfollicular mast cell infiltrates.
PTCL shows sheets of atypical T-cells with aberrant antigen loss and clonal TCR rearrangement, which mast cell infiltrates lack.
